skills.name: UI & OS Controls
skills.description: Core OS controls: Opening apps, typing, web browsing, clicking buttons (keyboard, click_text_fast, visual_click).

skills.name: Shell Commands
skills.description: Command prompt operations, creating directories, running scripts, file/folder manipulation via CLI.

skills.name: Background Email
skills.description: Sending background emails with optional attachments (send_email). No UI interaction needed.

skills.name: File Reading & Dispatch Router
skills.description: Routes file-reading tasks to the correct tool by extension. Handles CSV, JSON, JSONL, ZIP, TAR, plain text and logs. Delegates to word_docs, spreadsheets, or pdf_handling for heavy document types.

skills.name: Word Documents (DOCX)
skills.description: Create, read, and edit Word .docx files using python-docx. Handles headings, tables, images, lists, tracked changes, comments, headers/footers, and XML-level manipulation.

skills.name: Spreadsheets (XLSX / CSV)
skills.description: Create and edit Excel spreadsheets and CSV files using openpyxl and pandas. Formula-first principle, financial model color coding, data validation, and formula recalculation via LibreOffice.

skills.name: PDF Handling
skills.description: Read, extract, merge, split, rotate, and create PDF files. Handles text extraction, table extraction with pdfplumber, OCR for scanned PDFs, form fields, embedded attachments, and PDF creation with reportlab.

skills.name: File Editing & Code Workspace
skills.description: PRIMARY entry point for all file edits. Handles code and plain-text files directly (write_file, read_file, replace_in_file, modify_lines, append_file). Delegates to word_docs (.docx), spreadsheets (.xlsx/.csv), or pdf_handling (.pdf) for document-heavy tasks. AI-powered editing: ai_edit_word, ai_edit_excel, ai_edit_text.

skills.name: File Navigation & Web Automation
skills.description: Opening files/folders by fuzzy path, saving files, web automation and search (open_file, open_folder, save_file, web_automation).

skills.name: FlexiSIGN Automation
skills.description: FlexiSIGN automation: number plates, vinyl cutting, govt plates, bike/car plates. Overrides normal prompt entirely.

skills.name: Output Requirements
skills.description: Mandatory output format requirements for JSON responses. Auto-appended to every prompt.

skills.name: ReAct Loop Instructions
skills.description: Iterative Thought-Action-Observation loop instructions. Auto-appended when running in ReAct mode.
